name: Coder Code Server
description: Self-hosted VS Code in the browser. Installs the official Debian package natively in an LXC (no Docker) as a systemd user service on port 8680.

notes.text: UI binds 0.0.0.0:8680 with a generated password, printed once, stored in /root/.config/code-server/config.yaml. Set var_code_server_password, then restart code-server@root.
Debian/Ubuntu .deb packages only, so this uses the Debian 13 template (unprivileged). No Alpine install.
Workspaces live in the login user's home. Add a non-root user and log in as them to sandbox projects; otherwise files land in /root.
HA Ingress (`var_hass_ingress=yes`) adds code-server to the HA sidebar with HA-session auth and disables its own auth; needs the hass_ingress HACS integration.
Ingress setup: a ready-to-paste configuration.yaml snippet is written to /opt/code-server-ha-ingress.md. Integration: https://github.com/lovelylain/hass_ingress.
Update: `update` inside the LXC or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`; PHS_SILENT=1 for unattended. Web UI: http://<container-ip>:8680.
